name: Sarah Whittle
headline: MSc Global Business and Sustainability
current_role: Human Rights Intern at HEINEKEN Global
profile: Currently pursuing a Master’s in Global Business and Sustainability at RSM alongside an internship at HEINEKEN Global, gaining experience in stakeholder management, research, and international collaboration. Curious, adaptable, and people-oriented, I enjoy working with diverse teams, exploring creative ideas, and taking on new challenges.

bullets: Collaborating with global Operating Companies (OpCos) and senior stakeholders to strengthen human rights engagement and implementation across the organisation.
Analysing supplier sustainability audits, monitoring human rights risks and supporting remediation efforts across the global supply chain.
Researching EU human rights legislation, including the CSDDD and Forced Labour Regulation, and conducting peer benchmarking to support corporate sustainability practices.
Supporting DEI initiatives and developing internal communications, presentations and engagement projects to promote human rights awareness across global operations.

Community engagement, communications and event organisation.
Childcare and English-language educational, recreational and sports activities.
Research internship addressing the impact of changing civic spaces and how this influences the security training needs of INGO workers.
Coaching padel sessions for student members.
